tiktok.caption:
Everything feels urgent, so I do nothing. 🫠

Five things feel equally important, so I end up doing none of them. I avoid the big task by doing a million tiny ones.

So I picked one: invoices. FOCO broke it into four tiny steps. Step 1 was just opening last month's invoice. One step, one timer, jazz on. The other four can wait.

How many tabs do you have open? 👇
Save this for the next time you're stuck 📌

You don't need another to-do list. You need help starting. The app on the slides is FOCO, link in bio 💜
